Editor's note: this section has been amended by L.L. 2026/012, 1/3/2026, eff. 1/1/2028.
In special flood hazard areas, tank inlets, fill openings, outlets and vents shall be:
   1.   Installed at or above the design flood elevation specified in ASCE 24, Table 7-1, or designed to prevent the inflow of floodwater and outflow of the contents of the tanks during conditions of flooding to the design flood elevation, in accordance with ASCE 24; and
   2.   Anchored to prevent lateral movement resulting from hydrodynamic and hydrostatic loads, including the effects of buoyancy, during conditions of flooding to the design flood elevation, in accordance with ASCE 24.
Editor's note: For related unconsolidated provisions, see Appendix A at L.L. 2026/012.

 In special flood hazard areas, tank inlets, fill openings, outlets and vents shall be:

 2. Anchored to prevent lateral movement resulting from hydrodynamic and hydrostatic loads, including the effects of buoyancy, during conditions of flooding to the design flood elevation, in accordance with ASCE 24.
